emisearchplus.recipe_search.tip1: Filters the recipes on this screen (Extended+ syntax)
emisearchplus.recipe_search.tip3: @mod $tooltip $label>=10 #tag &id %%tab ~type =word  * wildcard  & or space = and  | or  -not  {group}  r/regex/  "text"
emisearchplus.config.searchMode.tooltip:
Extended+: GTNH NEI syntax ({group} | or -not r/regex/ "text").
EMI: EMI's original parser (the & %% ~ prefixes still work).
emisearchplus.config.syntaxHighlight.too:
Colors prefixes and operators and marks the ignored
part of the query in red (Extended+ only).
emisearchplus.config.recipeSearch.toolti:
A bar below the recipe screen that filters the shown recipes.
<inputs >outputs ^others (catalysts). Applies to the next screen opened.
emisearchplus.config.accentInsensitive.t: "pickaxe" also finds accented names. Changing it rebuilds the search index.
emisearchplus.config.initials.tooltip:
2 to 4 letter terms also match name initials
("ic" finds Iron Chestplate).
emisearchplus.config.fuzzy.tooltip:
Only if nothing found: retries the search allowing 1 typo (2 in long words).
Always: always includes approximate results.
emisearchplus.config.autocomplete.toolti:
Suggestions for @mod #tag &id %%tab while typing;
with an empty field shows recent searches. Tab completes.
emisearchplus.config.maxSuggestions.tool: How many suggestions to show at once (1 to 20).
emisearchplus.config.calculator.tooltip:
Type a sum (64*9+12, 3st+5, 1.5k/8) to see the result.
Enter replaces the text with it, Shift+Enter copies it.
emisearchplus.config.explicitAnd.tooltip:
On: only "&" (or "&&") combines terms and spaces become part of the text.
  iron ingot = name contains "iron ingot";  iron ingot & @create = that AND from Create.
  Terms next to each other without "&" are marked red (error).
Off: space means AND (NEI default). An attached "&text" is always an id search.
emisearchplus.config.englishNames.toolti:
With the game in another language, also matches the English name.
Changing it rebuilds the index.
emisearchplus.config.wildcards.tooltip:
"*" is a wildcard: tar* = a word starts with tar, *tar = ends with tar,
iron*ingot = anything in between. Quote it for a literal "*".
emisearchplus.config.highlightMatches.to:
On a filtered recipe screen, outlines in gold
the slots that matched the search.
emisearchplus.config.showResultCount.too: Shows how many items the search found inside the main bar.
emisearchplus.config.saveHistory.tooltip:
Keeps history and pinned searches between sessions
(config/emisearchplus-history.json).
Right-click a history entry to pin/unpin it (★).

emisearchplus.help.recipes.10: ?inv	Only recipes craftable with your inventory.
emisearchplus.help.recipes.11: ?scc	Only recipes whose item inputs are in the SCC terminal stock (open the terminal first).

emisearchplus.help.keys.2: `↑ ↓	Navigate suggestions; Enter applies the one chosen with the arrows.

emisearchplus.help.config.title: Configuration
emisearchplus.help.config.1: Everything can be toggled in EMI's config screen → "EMI Search Plus (EMIS+)" group (or the Config button in the mod list). Files: config/emisearchplus.json and config/emisearchplus-history.json.
emisearchplus.help.config.2: Search syntax: Extended+ (default, like GTNH's NEI) or original EMI.
emisearchplus.help.subtitle: EMIS+ — Help (click an example to use it)
emisearchplus.help.basic.1: iron	Name contains "iron" (also matches English names, ignores accents, matches initials).
emisearchplus.help.basic.2: iron ingot	Space = AND: every term must match the same item.
emisearchplus.help.basic.3: iron & ingot	A standalone "&" is also AND. With "Explicit AND", only & is AND and spaces become part of the text.
emisearchplus.help.basic.4: {iron|gold} ingot	{ } groups and | is OR: (iron OR gold) AND ingot. OR binds looser than AND.
emisearchplus.help.basic.5: ingot -@minecraft	"-" negates the next term or group: ingots not from Minecraft.
emisearchplus.help.basic.6: "iron ingot"	Quotes: exact text, spaces included, no wildcards.
emisearchplus.help.basic.7: r/^iron.*ingot$/	Regular expression (Java). Also after a prefix: @r/^create/.
emisearchplus.help.basic.8: =tar	"=" matches the whole word: finds "Tar" and "Bucket of Tar", not Mortar or Stardrop.
emisearchplus.help.basic.9: ="bucket of tar"	A phrase of whole words.
emisearchplus.help.basic.10: tar*	"*" at the end: some word starts with "tar" (Tar, Target).
emisearchplus.help.basic.11: *tar	"*" at the start: some word ends with "tar" (Mortar, Tar).
emisearchplus.help.basic.12: iron*ingot	"*" in the middle (or *tar*): any text in between, anywhere in the name.
emisearchplus.help.basic.14: The part that doesn't make sense is underlined in red and ignored; the rest of the search still applies.
emisearchplus.help.prefixes.2: =bucket	Whole word in the name (also English, accents ignored).
emisearchplus.help.prefixes.6: %combat	Creative tab (quote names with spaces: %"building blocks").
emisearchplus.help.prefixes.7: ~fluid	Stack type: item, fluid or others (Mekanism chemicals etc.).
emisearchplus.help.prefixes.8: $"attack damage">=10	Tooltip number: compares the first number on the line containing the label. Operators > >= < <= = !=, suffixes k m g.
emisearchplus.help.explicit_note: "Explicit AND" mode is on: only & combines terms and spaces are part of the text. The examples below are already written for this mode.
